description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [1.25.0] - 2026-09-26

### 🚀 Features

- Add a Discover screen for browsing books and audiobooks to request

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Show Continue Watching, Reading and Up Next as soon as they load
- Rename discovery request fallback local clashing with the request title

## [1.24.0] - 2026-09-26

### 🚀 Features

- Show pages left on books in progress

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Show a book's real author instead of Chaptarr's lowercase sort key

## [1.23.0] - 2026-09-26

### 🚀 Features

- Give books and audiobooks their own shelves with author and series rows
- Upgrade the book reader with layouts, search and a PDF text layer
- Add highlight, vocabulary, translation and dictionary endpoints for the reader
- Highlight, annotate, look up and translate text in the reader
- Add a vocabulary screen with flashcard review and Anki export

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Rename book search scope parameter clashing with a loop local
